description: This file contains template implementations of safe mathematical operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication) with support for compile-time checks and fallbacks, primarily for use in numeric computations within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CheckedAddFastOp
classes.description: Template class providing safe addition with overflow detection.

classes.name: CheckedSubFastOp
classes.description: Template class providing safe subtraction with overflow detection.

classes.name: CheckedMulFastOp
classes.description: Template class providing safe multiplication with support for Clang-specific optimizations.

classes.name: ClampedAddFastOp
classes.description: Template class for clamped addition operations.

classes.name: ClampedSubFastOp
classes.description: Template class for clamped subtraction operations.

classes.name: ClampedMulFastOp
classes.description: Template class for clamped multiplication operations.

classes.name: ClampedNegFastOp
classes.description: Template class for clamped negation operation.

methods.name: Do
methods.description: Performs the respective safe math operation, returning a boolean indicating success or failure, or the result directly in clamped operations.
